purpose: Test whether completed-bar oscillator and technical state on M1/M5/M15/M30/H1 adds portable information after price-path state is known for B02/F05 P3 establishment, P2 early continuation and P1 giveback termination.

distinct_from_closed_work.HYP-023: not referenced, rerun, repaired or used to generate candidates
distinct_from_closed_work.HYP-024: not referenced, rerun, repaired or used to generate candidates
distinct_from_closed_work.HYP-025: price-only result retained only as a comparison baseline; no cell repair, chaining or retuning

labels.P3: common-M1 baseline loser with no executable favorable excursion
labels.P2: common-M1 baseline loser with a favorable excursion but no +10 pip event
labels.winner_comparators: P3: all ever-profitable trades; P2: final winners aligned at first positive mark; P1: final winners reaching +10 pips

P2.unit: minutes after first positive executable mark

P1.unit: minutes after first +10 pip executable mark

observation_contract.execution_timing: feature bar must be completed at or before observation timestamp; no future or partial bar

direction_normalization: signed features multiplied by trade side; bounded oscillators transformed so higher means stronger in trade direction

tests.univariate: fold-specific medians, rank-biserial effect, Benjamini-Hochberg q, all-four-fold sign consistency

models.preprocessing: training-fold median imputation then training-fold standardization

incremental_gate.univariate_support: at least one feature with same effect direction in all folds and absolute rank-biserial effect >= 0.10 in every fold

prohibited: MT4 execution before a separately preregistered portable candidate exists
process_disclosure: The outcome-free preregistration was committed before results on a research branch but was not merged to main before local execution. Results are therefore closed as an independently reproducible audit and cannot authorize a binding candidate.
